steps.text: Cut. Cut the potato open, and put it into the water piece by piece. Skulls are much harder to cut.
Tear. The softest tissues in the human body are like cotton candy, easily scattered by a gloved hand.
Crush. Flowers are crushed in the trembling palm, the juices sticking to the skin, dripping onto new leather shoes.
Scream. The instruments sever the nerves so quickly that it can take a life without its owner noticing, just like the use of anesthetics.
Cry. My dead brothers cry on the operating table. Why were they the ones who had to be killed? Why was I the one who was made to live?
No. No.
They are not dead yet. They are behind me, hammering and crying.
There was never a garden. There was only cruel imprisonment and cutting, the cage that treated our lives like toys.
They want to destroy the cage.
As do I.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The lab walls are being torn apart? They're made of advanced reinforced materials... how they be sliced apart like potatoes?

options: That's what I was most afraid of.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Th-The ground is being peeled like an apple!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We'll be crushed into pulp!

options: Amiya could calm Rosmontis down. But she's not here.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You don't mean you're going by yourself, do you?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Did you see how she shredded that power armor like paper? You're just a regular human! You are human, right?

spans.text: Did you see how she shredded that power armor like paper? You're just a regular human! You

options: Then I won't leave Rosmontis behind.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: ...I'll go.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: This is no time for jokes, Iffy!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The Diαblo within you... well, your power is plenty dangerous too. Don't tell me you mean to...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I won't use its power. I'll do it myself.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: That's a promise between me and Rosmontis.

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Requesting... support...

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: The communicator... it's crushed?

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: What the heck are...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Don't.

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I know what you want to say. Don't say it.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: She's my friend. My good friend.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: We're more than friends. We work together and fight together.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Rosmontis...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...I'll destroy everything that's not right.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: A lab like this...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: It should never have existed.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I get it.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Damned lab coats, damned labs, all those damned things that tormented us should have been burned to ashes a long time ago!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Of course we have the right to be angry, to yell, to destroy it all!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: But we don't have to do it!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Are you going to stand in the way of what's right?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You're tough... but it'll take more than that to stop me!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I won't let you become like Darya, Rosmontis... we promised to see the city together, and go back to Rhodes Island together!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I don't want to admit it, but you've always been better than I am! You're an elite operator, and you've done so many amazing things.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Think of Amiya, think of Blaze the big cat, think of the Doctor! They have soft palms, their clothes smell clean, and they hug like warm blankets!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Blankets...?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: There are people who love us. Life isn't fair, but after all the scum we had to put up with, we still ended up meeting some really good people.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence's stories always have a happy ending. I know, she made up a bunch of them.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Saria is always strict about my homework, but she helps me up when I fall down.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Don't destroy these memories.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You can stop now, Rosmontis.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Stop...?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I-Ifri...
The vibrations weaken.
Ifrit grabs Rosmontis' hand.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Yes, Ifrit. You remember me. No way you could forget. You didn't find out I ate those cookies you hid yet.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yes... I think you're right.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It wasn't the Doctor who ate the cookies. I should correct the terminal entry.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hahah... hahahaha!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You look like you're hurting. Why are you laughing?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I want to laugh.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You didn't lose control, right? Even the Doctor was worried about it. But you just wanted to do what you wanted to do in your own way.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: It's okay, Saria's worried that I'll lose control too. It's not a lack of trust. They just worry too much.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: As for the bad guys... the power they planted in us, the scars they left behind, none of that can control us.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: We're the only ones who can.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: We can turn the tables and laugh in their faces.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Like... like this?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Yes. Lift the corners of your mouth, find that Loken, and tell him he's nothing to you!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Loken.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Alright, I'll find him. I know what to say now.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: ...Things have calmed down.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ifrit did it. She calmed Rosmontis down. Talk about a close one...
Rosmontis's Arts left cracks in the walls around you.
The walls of the maze have been destroyed, revealing a hallway deeper into the building.

options: What is that room for, Muelsyse?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Huh?

options: Why is there a vivarium in H.A.M.H.R.R.?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Kristen remembered...
'Sarcophagus.'
You are sure you saw the Sarcophagus.
It is unmistakable. It is the starting point of all memories you have.
Even the dizziness is exactly the same.

options: Loken is helping Kristen study the sarcophagus?
What does Kristen need the sarcophagus for?
Does she want to destroy herself?
She'll turn into a strange, white-furred creature!

steps.text: Muelsyse does not answer.
You reach out and touch nothing.
There is only a small splash, the reflection of bubbles.
The real Muelsyse stands at the heart of the vivarium.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Doctor... I promised to take you and Rosmontis to see Loken.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Our cooperation is over, now that its goal is complete.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You can't go any further. We say goodbye here.

options: You planned this from the beginning.
That's how you got the address.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I lied again. I really am evil, aren't I?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That hard-head, Nasti... I told her I made my choice, when I really hadn't.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I only just now made it, the moment I saw this vivarium.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I came only to confirm one thing... yes, this is where my dreams are. The vivarium and the future it carries... this is my dream.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It's the answer for me and my people.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Kristen promised to take it with her.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: She didn't lie to me. She just didn't tell me... maybe she got tired of my cloaks and daggers, how a part of me never seems to be there. Maybe she never stopped believing in the trust between us.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: She really did it...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: So I should keep my promise.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Tell Saria... I'm sorry.
The water pushes you away. It is soft, but irresistible.
You return to the outer hallway, the lab doors closing before you.
The water disappears, leaving no trace behind. Your hand is empty again, but this is no longer just an intermission in the middle of a dance.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It's time. Can I go now?

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: The deal is done. You can leave at any time.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You promised me...

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: You'll find it on your terminal.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Is this the entirety of Loken's research?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: No, there's another address... a blurred one. It looks familiar. You've really done a lot right under Maylander's nose. I'm starting to actually respect you.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: What a shame.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: You won't see the sky that you should have gotten to see.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: The stars? My people have played with them long enough. I've given you all the information I should. Do you really think those twisted spots of light are worth looking at?

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: No, not the sky we see today.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Its true aspect, in the future.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Enough. I know about your great plans, but that future doesn't belong to me. As long as your data is legit, I'll be able to fulfill my ancestors' dream and recover my true power—

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: The power that you desire could not even overcome time. You understand that it could be machines that fly the skies of the future, or other evolving lifeforms...

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: But not a shadow from ten thousand years ago.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Are you mocking me... mocking my blood, my memory, my destiny?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Sacrificing your entire race just to return to the past... is it really worth it?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Whatever. I've got what I wanted. Let's say goodbye in peace.
Ho'olheyak jumps down the monitoring platform.
She does not turn around to look at Kristen. She does not want Kristen to see the look on her face.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: We meet again.
They are silent for a moment.
Past and future pass by each other, without making contact.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I can't get the door open!

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's... the weapon you lent me?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Not lent. Gave. It's yours. You just need practice.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Practice... er...

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: You're free, once you go out from here. The agents and soldiers are too busy to bother. They've found H.A.M.H.R.R. and achieved their goal. They won't bother you anymore.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Run to Trimounts. There, you'll still be Researcher Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: You want to go in the most dangerous direction, don't you? You could put your life in danger. You may never be able escape Maylander's gaze ever again.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: It'll be a struggle of a lifetime. You may lose some things forever. Freedom, the life you know, the trust of your family and friends, the right to live under the sun, and yourself.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Are you sure you want a life like that?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't know. I haven't seen the problem resolved with my own eyes. I don't want to give up halfway.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: You're a talented scholar, a good doctor. Have you made up your mind to become a warrior?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Maybe I'll never be a warrior.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But I'll grasp the weapon you gave me tight, if necessary.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Very well, child. Go forth with my blessing.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Thank you, Director Jara.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: By the way, Control... Kristen could be just ahead.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Don't you want to see her?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Do I? Of course I do.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: But I doubt I can catch her.
Jara gazes at the laboratory.
Then, she turns her gaze toward the sky.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: You got it yet?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Not yet!

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Keep going. The core of H.A.M.H.R.R. should be in here.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: And Kristen... she couldn't have escaped right under our noses.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: ...Ifrit?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Saria! Did you find a way in?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: This place is weird. Even after Rosmontis crushed most of the outer wall like a cookie, it's not revealing any of the stuff inside.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: ...It's not a complete building.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You're right, Ifrit. It's not a lab.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: This is... it's...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Did she install her parents' propulsion device on... how could it be? No... how did I not think of it until now?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Saria! Where are you going?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: If I break the wall...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: She must have expected me. It's pointless.
Then what has a point?
You can't change anything.
Would we be too late?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I have to...
Have to what?
Saria.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Si...lence?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You need to get out of here... it could be...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Saria, I didn't come here to listen to you talk like that.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I know how far a scientist would go for her dream. I know that feeling of rapture, which is why I know the strength it takes to fight it with morality.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You've long been seeking a balance between science and order. You do well; perhaps too well.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Your order is falling apart. But if you're willing to let balance go... perhaps you'll find your roots amidst the chaos.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Find my... roots?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I believe you can.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We have all things to do. Let's part here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I can tell you now, Saria.

a.text: How much I looked up to you.
How much I wanted to walk by your side.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, there goes a rare friend.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: How do you plan on making it up to me, Kristen?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Narcissa... You've returned. Are you ready to pronounce judgment?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yes, I want to kill you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Not for revenge. I hate you, but Amiya and the Doctor both say that revenge won't bring back the ones I love.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Not for destruction. You want to use me to destroy you. I won't. I'm not your weapon.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're just a criminal. You're nothing to me.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'll do what the law and prison could not do.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I hereby sentence you to death.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Good... good.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: How does that song go again?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Country roads♪ Take me home♪

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: To the place I belong♪

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Soon. Very soon.
Severe tremors shake the earth.
Like something very strong and resilient is about to break out.
You gaze at the rising inner corridor, and see a figure through the windows.
Kristen.
A name that has been on many lips these days.
Lunatic. Genius. Foe. Friend.
Or perhaps a dreamer who does not belong to this time.
You see her with your own eyes for the first time. She continues to look up at the sky, as though the blank emptiness is the only thing she should care about.

options: You cannot remain on your feet!

steps.text: A familiar silhouette appears.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Screeches)
It unfolds in an instant, grabbing your shoulders lightly with sharp claws, the massive figure covering you fully.
Then, an even more massive shadow rises behind Mon3tr.
H.A.M.H.R.R..
Now you can see that the mysterious ring corridor and Muelsyse's vivarium are both part of H.A.M.H.R.R..
Maylander and the military fought over it, then made peace over it, but no one could have predicted that it would reveal itself in this way.
The bright flames of the thrusters feel blinding. The blast throws you off your feet.
If not for Kal'tsit and Mon3tr, you would have been cast to the winds, like those around you, and the broken remains of the lab.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hang on, Doctor.

options: I didn't know Kristen's lab could fly.
We were so close to the truth...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I know.
The figure in the air casts her gaze at you.
No, not at you. The dark monster that is protecting you.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Growls)
Kristen moves her lips, seemingly inquiringly.
You hear Kal'tsit repeat her answer to you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —I know.
